issue.title: Apply the server's "free creations used up" answer on RN
issue.body:
## What

When `/api/generate-image` answers `403 { ok: false, code: "FREE_GRANT_EXHAUSTED", remaining: 0, … }` (the response from `exhaustedGrant()` in `web/src/routes/api/generate-image/+server.ts`), both arms close the card and open Settings › AI Art.

Shipping then applies the answer:
- AI Art says "Your 10 free AI creations are used up. Add your own OpenAI API key to keep creating.";
- it scrolls to the key field;
- the drawer button becomes "Set up AI image".

RN web keeps the stale allowance:
- AI Art still says "10 free AI creations left. No setup is needed.";
- the drawer button still reads "Create AI image, 10 free left".

## Why

Ledger rows B0277 and L0155. After the server has refused, RN invites the child to tap again, and every tap sends another doomed request and bounces back to Settings.

## Where

`experiments/native-architecture/src/ai/transport.ts` (`generationReply` maps `FREE_GRANT_EXHAUSTED` to `reason: 'exhausted'`) and `ai/session.ts` / `product/useAiAvailability.ts`. The exhausted failure has to update the free-generation state the badge and AI Art read. Shipping: `web/src/lib/state/freeGenerations.svelte.ts`.

## Repro (rn-web, Chromium, iPhone-sized touch profile)

1. At 00fcc5c78d1031873db1a214301c008daa4bd080, build and serve the RN web export.
2. Use a fixture `/api/*` where the grant answers `{ ok: true, remaining: 10, limit: 10 }` and generate-image answers the 403 above.
3. Turn AI on with Customize AI Style off, draw, and tap Create AI image.
4. Expected: AI Art says the free creations are used up, and the drawer shows Set up AI image. Actual: "10 free AI creations left", and "Create AI image, 10 free left".

Evidence: AI-1 record, cell `ai-exhausted-mid-run` (`docs/scratchpad/2026-10-18-device-parity/results/ai-1-web-2026-10-19.md` on branch `claude/rn-web-parity-cloud`).

## Done when

- An exhausted answer sets the free count to 0 everywhere it shows, as shipping does, on RN web and native.
- AI-1 cell `ai-exhausted-mid-run` matches.

Refs #2978
issue.display_title: Apply the server's "free creations used up" answer on RN

comments.body:
Fixed by #3047, merged into `codex/native-migration` as 6f845cb33fb52f00570d8d85ac325719a8ee5734.

**Rerun.** The AI-1 cell `ai-exhausted-mid-run` was rerun on rn-web-chromium against an export that includes the fix. The record's `/api` fixture answered every request, so no generation was charged. The fixture's 403 `FREE_GRANT_EXHAUSTED` closes the card and opens AI Art. AI Art says the 10 free creations are used up, and the wand reads "Set up AI image". Both match web-prod's recorded values. The rerun note and the `PROTOCOL_RERUN` rows for B0277 and L0155 are in #3052.

**Native.** The fix is in the shared product owner (`session.ts`, `generationController`, `createDrawingProduct`), which native and web both run. `native-ai-flow-owner.test.mjs` drives that owner directly. No simulator or emulator run checked it, and B0277 and L0155 stay unverified until AI-1 covers their native targets.

**Review.** Codex reviewed #3047 twice. Its round-2 findings (a race between a grant and a later answer, a policy change, and the sources of zero) were fixed after round 2. The fixes were not re-reviewed, because PRs here get at most two rounds.

**Not covered here.** On this path, focus lands on the AI Art heading on rn-web and on Settings' Back button on web-prod. That difference was also present on 2026-10-19. No row covers it, and it is not filed.
